name: Last Rider
source:
In a world kept safe thanks to the work of The Masked Rider, the beloved superhero fighting off monsters every week, there is nothing to fear. 

On the day that these monsters suddenly evolve into brutal, bloodthirsty beasts, there is an unforeseen level of carnage and brutality trailing behind our masked defender. Only one man can stop them: You aren't him.

[From [url=https://mangoslushboba.itch.io/last-rider-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在蒙面骑士这个每周都会与怪物战斗的受人喜爱的超级英雄的努力下，世界变得安全，没有什么可害怕的。

当这些怪物突然进化成残忍、嗜血的野兽的那一天，我们的蒙面防御者身后就会出现不可预见的屠杀和残暴。只有一个人可以阻止他们：你不是他。

[来自[url=https://mangoslushboba.itch.io/last-rider-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
